entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's broken. The heart rate reading is nonsense and it just won't sync with the app anymore. I think the device is defective.
I see. Thank you for clarifying that. Let me just pull up your order information to check on the return eligibility. Can I have your name and order number, please?
Thank you, Alex. One moment while I review this... Okay, I see your order. You received the VeloBand Pulse on December 15th, so it's been 23 days.

Well, I've just checked our policy, and it looks like you're well within the 90-day return window. Since you're saying the item is defective, I can go ahead and process a full return for you right now.
Oh. Fine. I was expecting to have to argue about this. So you're just going to take it back?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated that for you. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 10 minutes. Just pack the item back in its original box and attach the label. Once we receive the unit, we'll process a full refund.
Whatever. As long as it gets done.
It will. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Alex. Have a good rest of your day.
